notes: Data taken directly from Black Box's official Quick Install Guide and User Manual for the KVX Series (covers KVXLCH-100, KVXLCHF-100, KVXLCH-200, KVXLCHF-200, KVXLCHDP-200, KVXLCHDPF-200). The KVXLCHDP-200 is the dual-head HDMI/DisplayPort model with CATx (RJ-45) link — distinct from KVXLCHDPF-200 which uses fiber/SFP instead of RJ-45. This is a 2-piece TX+RX extender kit (both units' ports combined into this one device record). Each unit is a small desktop enclosure (1.71 x 7.09 x 3.27 in), not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted. Both TX and RX also have a chassis ground screw, not modeled as a signal/power port. HDMI/DP grades (1.4 / 1.2) are inferred from the stated max resolution/refresh (4K@30Hz, 3840x2160@30Hz) since the manual does not explicitly state HDMI/DisplayPort version numbers. The CATx RJ-45 link port is a proprietary KVM-extension link (not switched Ethernet) so no eth-x.x grade was applied; manufacturer states only max cable distance (100m/330ft), not a link speed class. Manufacturer's own product page (blackbox.com) returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch, so the official QIG/user manual PDF hosted on Black Box's own asset CDN was used instead; its spec tables match the B&H, Newegg, and ProVantage retailer listings found via search (confirms 4K@30Hz max resolution, 2x HDMI-out + DP/HDMI-in on TX, 2x HDMI-out + 4x USB-A on RX, RS-232, analog audio, CATx 100m).

ports.name: HDMI IN
ports.note: Transmitter host video input; max 4K @ 30Hz (3840x2160@30Hz), consistent with HDMI 1.4 bandwidth. Version not explicitly stated by manufacturer, inferred from resolution/refresh spec.

ports.name: DP IN
ports.note: Transmitter host video input (DisplayPort); max 4K @ 30Hz. DP version not explicitly stated, inferred from resolution/refresh spec.

ports.name: HDMI OUT
ports.note: Transmitter local video loopback output; max 4K @ 30Hz.

ports.name: USB
ports.note: Transmitter host-side USB connection (USB Type B female) for transparent USB 2.0/1.1 extension to source computer.

ports.name: RS232
ports.note: DB9 female serial extension port on transmitter, fixed at 115,200 baud.

ports.name: CATx
ports.note: Link port to receiver over CAT5e/CATx cable, max 100m (330 ft). Proprietary KVM extension link, not switched Ethernet; no bandwidth grade specified by manufacturer.

ports.name: Mic (audio jack)
ports.note: Transmitter analog audio Line In / microphone input jack (2-way analog audio extension).

ports.name: Speaker (audio jack)
ports.note: Transmitter analog audio Line Out / headphone-speaker output jack.

ports.name: DC 5V
ports.note: Transmitter power input; external 5VDC, 2A power supply.

ports.name: HDMI-OUT (1)
ports.note: Receiver console video output 1 of 2 (dual-head); max 4K @ 30Hz. RX only has HDMI outputs even though TX accepts HDMI+DP inputs.

ports.name: HDMI-OUT (2)
ports.note: Receiver console video output 2 of 2 (dual-head); max 4K @ 30Hz.

ports.name: USB 2.0 (x4)
ports.note: Receiver has four USB 2.0 Type A female device ports for keyboard/mouse/other USB peripherals.

ports.name: RS232
ports.note: DB9 male serial extension port on receiver, fixed at 115,200 baud.

ports.name: CATx
ports.note: Link port to transmitter over CAT5e/CATx cable, max 100m (330 ft).

ports.name: Mic (audio jack)
ports.note: Receiver analog audio Mic In jack.

ports.note: Receiver analog audio Speaker Out jack.
